orders = [
    {"order_id": 2574, "total": 65.0, "channel": "mobile app", "country": "Canada"},
    {"order_id": 2069, "total": 18.0, "channel": "mobile app", "country": "United States"},
    {"order_id": 1200, "total": 33.0, "channel": "mobile app", "country": "united kingdom"},
    {"order_id": 1809, "total": 35.0, "channel": "web", "country": "United States"},
    {"order_id": 1434, "total": 72.0, "channel": None, "country": "Saudi Arabia"},
    {"order_id": 2089, "total": 58.0, "channel": "marketplace", "country": "UNITED KINGDOM"},
    {"order_id": 2490, "total": 89.0, "channel": "web", "country": "United Arab Emirates"},
    {"order_id": 2985, "total": 24.0, "channel": "web", "country": "United Kingdom"},
    {"order_id": 2544, "total": 58.0, "channel": "mobile app", "country": "Jordan"},
    {"order_id": 2375, "total": 329.0, "channel": "mobile app", "country": "United Kingdom"},
    {"order_id": 1129, "total": 29.0, "channel": "web", "country": "United States"},
    {"order_id": 1176, "total": 44.0, "channel": "web", "country": "United States"},
]
revenue_by_country = {}
for order in orders:
    country = order["country"].strip().title()
    revenue_by_country[country] = revenue_by_country.get(country, 0) + order["total"]
large_ids = [o["order_id"] for o in orders if o["total"] >= 60]
web_count = 0
for o in orders:
    if o["channel"] == "web":
        web_count += 1

checks.test: sorted(revenue_by_country) == ['Canada', 'Jordan', 'Saudi Arabia', 'United Arab Emirates', 'United Kingdom', 'United States']
